name: piforge
description: Pi 5 personal workbench + Raspberry Pi console with OpenCode v2 agent platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @piforge/shared && npm run build -w @piforge/gateway && npm run build -w @piforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @piforge/shared && npm run typecheck -w @piforge/gateway && npm run typecheck -w @piforge/web
